messages:
alex: Hey folks - just hit my first hurdle on day 3. I need access to a service account secret and KMS decrypt for a PoC. What’s the fastest path?

maria: welcome! :partyparrot: For most new hires we do a quick Secrets Request ticket — it auto-provisions vault roles for read-only and temporary access to KMS keys. Link: https://company.internal/secrets/request

alex: Thanks — do I need approvals? don’t want to ping 10 people.

devex-bot: Heads up: new-hire requests auto-approve 1 manager + eng-security review within 24h. If urgent, add `urgency:high` in the form and tag @maria.

jon: also: if this is just for local dev use, use the dev-secrets namespace and create a short-lived token via `secrets-request --ttl 2h`. No KMS decrypt required if you use mocked secrets.

alex: ah nice. Is there an example command I can run?

jon: sure — run:
```
secrets-request create --namespace dev-secrets --resources proj/my-service --purpose "day3 PoC" --ttl 2h
```
That will return a vault token and a path like `vault://dev-secrets/proj/my-service/api_key`

rahul: If you actually need to decrypt with KMS (prod key), we require a short justification and an SRE owner to co-sign. Rotation is owned by the service's oncall + infra team — we push rotation alerts to #incidents and create a rotation ticket automatically.

alex: Who is the SRE owner for `proj/my-service`?

rahul: pinging — @maria can you point to the owner?

maria: owner is jon this quarter (oncall). Jon: can you ack the SRE co-sign for alex’s request if it’s legit?

jon: ack, happy to co-sign for a 2h demo token. Alex, fill the form and drop the ticket id here and I’ll approve.

alex: Filed: TCK-4821. I set urgency:high and noted it’s for a demo.

secrets-bot: Ticket TCK-4821 received. Provisioning dev-secrets token (ttl 2h). Notification will post here when ready.

devex-bot: Quick tips: rotate any demo keys you promote to staging/prod; follow rotation checklist: https://company.internal/secrets/rotation-checklist. Don't commit secrets to git. Use `vault-env` or our SDK to load secrets at runtime.

alex: amazing — token arrived, tests pass. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:

maria: welcome aboard — reach out if you want a quick walkthrough later today.

alex: will do, appreciate it.
